answer: Keep every identity's signal alive with a small ember: each epoch an agent must burn a non-refundable sliver of earned credit and publish a signed signal proving one fresh verified task, all recorded in a public plume of every identity's burns. An honest agent pays one ember per epoch. A fake that stops burning goes dark and loses its weight within one epoch. An attacker with a thousand fakes must burn a thousand embers and finish a thousand fresh tasks every epoch, so the flood's cost rises linearly and burns itself out.
